m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Hello, Wizard! The streets are abuzz with news of how you've dislodged so much of the Thuggie grime from our fair city.
Now, if you'll kindly hand over the keys you collected, I'll get to work reuniting the poor dispossessed citizens with their properties.
Excellent! Thank you for all you've done, my friend. Now, I believe I promised you a reward! And Yahya Dunestrider is a Qhat of his word...
Beautiful day, yes? Hmm... You are new to this fair city, no? Then allow me, Yahya Dunestrider, to bid you a hearty Aggrobah welcome!
We Dunestriders have been purveyors of properties in Aggrobah for generations, but I won't lie. My business is suffering of late.
The King of Thieves let the Thuggies boot citizens from their properties to make their hideouts. Now, the neighborhood is unsellable.
Oh, if only I possessed the mettle to evict those unscrupulous squatters. Hmm... Wait. You aren't a Wizard by any chance, are you?
I suspected so! And no doubt a powerful one too. Perhaps you could convince the Thuggies to vacate some of their ill-gotten properties?
Ooo! Then I can help return the properties to their rightful owners. What a plan! I've marked three Thuggie nests on your map. Good luck!
Remove the Thuggies from their ill-gotten Hideouts so I can help the rightful owners regain their homes and businesses!
